questions.question: Which requirement most strongly makes an edge execution path necessary?
options: A safety action must complete within 40 ms even when the WAN is unavailable
A monthly report may finish overnight
A team prefers using more clusters
Historical data must train one global model
questions.explanation: A bounded local deadline plus disconnected autonomy cannot depend on a cloud round trip.

questions.question: A camera emits 336 Mbps of raw data and local filtering removes 96%. Approximately how much crosses the uplink?
options: 13.44 Mbps
32.26 Mbps
201.6 Mbps
322.56 Mbps

questions.question: What is the cloud control plane responsible for in a healthy edge architecture?
options: Fleet identity, policy, staged releases, model distribution, and global coordination
Every time-critical actuator decision
Bypassing local authorization
Assuming every node is continuously connected
questions.explanation: The cloud coordinates the fleet while bounded local decisions remain on the edge data path.

questions.question: Why must edge events have stable identities before replay?
options: So an ambiguous upload retry can be deduplicated without repeating a business effect
So clocks never drift
So buffers need no capacity limit
So all conflicts can use last-write-wins
questions.explanation: Stable event or operation IDs make at-least-once transfer compatible with idempotent effects.

questions.question: What should happen when both an isolated store and the cloud changed the same inventory fact?
options: Apply a versioned domain merge or quarantine the conflict under an explicit business rule
Trust whichever clock timestamp is larger
Silently discard all local sales
Replay both changes repeatedly
questions.explanation: Concurrent business facts require version evidence and domain semantics, not an arbitrary clock winner.

questions.question: Which deployment strategy best limits a bad edge software release?
options: Signed immutable artifacts, small cohorts, health gates, and a tested rollback
Deploy every node simultaneously
Disable version reporting
Require physical access for every recovery
questions.explanation: A heterogeneous remote fleet needs staged evidence and remote recovery before broad rollout.

questions.question: Which signal reveals that disconnected operation may exhaust local storage?
options: Buffer headroom expressed as time at the current event rate
Fleet-average CPU alone
Cloud request latency alone
The number of dashboard panels
questions.explanation: Time-to-full connects event volume, record size, retention, and remaining local capacity.

questions.question: When is cloud-primary execution usually the better fit?
options: The work is elastic and global, tolerates network delay, and does not need offline autonomy
An actuator must stop a machine during a WAN outage
Raw data exceeds the uplink and can be reduced locally
A local authorization decision must survive disconnection
questions.explanation: Central compute is strongest for elastic coordinated work when latency and connectivity are not hard constraints.
